summary: Iterates every string entry of the module callback table dword_7C73E0, copies each entry into a reallocating buffer, strips the file extension by null-terminating at the last '.' (decimal 46), and creates a UI menu item per base name via UIMenuItemCreator. Falls back to byte_5EA438 when the copied buffer is empty. Frees each allocated buffer and returns the entry count.

operations.description: Calls StateCleanupNotification(this) to perform state cleanup / notification on the UI object before rebuilding its items.
Calls VirtualPropertyAccessor(dword_7C73E0) to retrieve the entry count from the module callback table.
Iterates over entries from index 0 to count-1, rebuilding each UI menu item from its string entry.
Initializes the copy buffer pair v10 to {NULL, -1} before each entry is copied.
Calls IndexedEntryAccessor(dword_7C73E0, entry_index) to obtain the string entry at the current index.
Calls StringCopyWithBufferRealloc on the buffer pair v10 with the entry string, copying it into a reallocated heap buffer.
If the copied buffer is empty, falls back to byte_5EA438 as the default string.
Walks backward from the end of the string looking for the '.' (decimal 46) extension separator.
If a '.' is found beyond the first character, null-terminates the string there, truncating the file extension.
Calls UIMenuItemCreator(this, base_name, 0, 0, 0, 0) to create a UI menu item labelled with the extension-free base name.
If the copy buffer was allocated, frees it via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Returns the entry count after the loop completes.
